answer.reason: Judaea is a region, but two events of the story belong to it: the crowds going out to John for baptism, and the scattering of the church by persecution.

clauses.english: went out to John the Baptist and was baptized by him in the Jordan
clauses.quote: there went out unto him all the land of Judaea

clauses.english: saw the church scattered abroad by a great persecution
clauses.quote: they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judaea and Samaria

doubts: Most marked verses only name Judaea as a place of origin, travel or audience, so they were left out.
